title: Align bun.lock with package-lock.json
request: Work on the still open tasks: bun.lock vs package-lock.json sync

criteria.text: After the change, bun.lock resolves every direct dependency to the same version as package-lock.json (script: direct dependencies compared N, different 0; today 8 of 108 differ, 6 of them runtime: react, react-dom, @tanstack/react-query, framer-motion, lucide-react, react-window)
criteria.evidence: Comparison script on the committed files (saved: .factory/evidence/T-261106-align-bun-lock-with-pack/compare.txt): before, direct dependencies compared 108, different 8 (react, react-dom, @tanstack/react-query, framer-motion, lucide-react, react-window, knip, typescript-eslint); after (commit 577ba7e), compared 108, different 0, missing 0. Whole lock: the two files held 1159 name@version pairs each, 174 differed before, 0 differ after. Method: bun install --lockfile-only (bun 1.4.4) migrated the file from package-lock.json; no hand edits. The owner said yes to this change in chat.

criteria.text: package-lock.json and package.json are byte-identical to before; bun install --frozen-lockfile succeeds on the new bun.lock
criteria.evidence: git diff shows only bun.lock changed (package.json and package-lock.json: 0 changed lines). A frozen bun install of this exact file (byte-identical, cmp) in a scratch folder: 999 packages installed, no error. The 'Blocked 1 postinstall' line is bun's normal untrusted-script notice.

criteria.text: A bun-installed copy of the repo (frozen install in a scratch folder) builds with npm run build, the same way the deploy does
criteria.evidence: Scratch copy of the repo (git archive HEAD, then this bun.lock), bun install --frozen-lockfile, then npm run build with placeholder Vite variables: exit 0, 'built in 5.44s', dist has assets (log: .factory/evidence/T-261106-align-bun-lock-with-pack/build-bun-installed-copy.log). bun's configVersion is 0 for a migrated file (it was 1); frozen installs with 0 and with 1 give the same node_modules (1058 package.json files, no diff).

criteria.text: Six checks pass at the final commit; independent code review approves
criteria.evidence: Six checks pass at the final commit 577ba7e (integrity, typecheck, lint, knip, build, unit: all exit 0; the app files did not change, only bun.lock). Independent code review: APPROVE with three open points for the owner (integrity hashes, Lovable package cache, bun 1.4.0 or newer), recorded in the review summary.

reviews.summary: Independent review (factory-reviewer, read-only, own scripts) of commit 577ba7e: APPROVE as it stands, with three open points for the owner. VERIFIED by the reviewer: only bun.lock changed; package.json and package-lock.json byte-identical; 108 of 108 direct dependencies match package-lock.json (old file: 8 differ); the same 1,159 name@version pairs on both sides; workspaces and overrides agree with package.json; the file is byte-identical when regenerated with bun install --lockfile-only (no hand edits); frozen installs on bun 1.4.0 and 1.4.4 work and give the same node_modules as npm ci on Linux x64 apart from five wasm32 helper packages; native binaries for all platforms are kept; configVersion 0 and 1 install the same layout. OPEN POINTS, to the owner: (A) 604 of 1,233 entries have no integrity hash, where the old file had hashes for all; the gap is inherited from package-lock.json, and regenerating it does not fix it (npm 12 --package-lock-only keeps the same 606 entries without integrity; a full npm 12 install refuses the Lovable cache host); (B) 213 entries now download from the Lovable package cache (the old file used npmjs only), the same 214 URLs package-lock.json already has; (E) lockfileVersion 3 needs bun 1.4.0 or newer on the deploy (bun 1.3.x rejects it), same before and after this commit. The reviewer did not run the build; I did (scratch copy, exit 0).

notes.text: BLOCKED by the factory guard: bun.lock is in protectedPaths in .factory/config.json ('FACTORY GUARD: bun.lock is protected (artwork, secrets or history). Ask the human.'). Nothing was changed. Measured read-only before the block: bun frozen install passes, but 155 of 1023 top-level packages and 8 of 108 direct dependencies resolve to different versions in the two lock files (runtime: react 19.3.0 npm vs 19.3.1 bun, react-dom same, @tanstack/react-query 5.105.0 vs 5.104.5, framer-motion 14.7.1 vs 14.6.0, lucide-react 1.62.0 vs 1.61.0, react-window 2.5.1 vs 2.5.0). So CI tests one set and a frozen bun deploy would install another. Needs the owner's yes to touch bun.lock. Plan: delete bun.lock, run bun install --lockfile-only so bun migrates the versions from package-lock.json, then verify the 4 criteria.

Open points for the owner, not fixed here because they need a decision and touch package-lock.json (the CI lock): (A) the new bun.lock has no integrity hash for 604 packages (inherited from package-lock.json; npm 12 does not fill them); (B) 213 packages download from the Lovable package cache; (E) the deploy needs bun 1.4.0 or newer. A deploy has not been tried: the file is not deployed until the owner merges.
